external:core/canonical-product-action.j.title: Canonical Product Action
external:core/canonical-product-action.j.description: Fine-grained action template advertised on a compact product. The resulting MediaBuy exposes the authoritative routed task in available_actions.

verifier_constraints.constraint_action_compatibility: The constraints.kind is compatible with action under change-term-constraints.json. Product constraints are advisory and a proposal must restate binding bounds.

constraints.description: Advisory machine-readable bounds for product selection; proposal change terms restate binding bounds.

terms_ref.description: Optional advisory pointer to published commercial terms. It is not a proposal change-term identity.

external:enums/canonical-media-buy-actio.title: Canonical Media Buy Action Name
external:enums/canonical-media-buy-actio.description: Fine-grained MediaBuy action vocabulary for compact product and lifecycle surfaces. Deprecated coarse 3.x actions are absent.

external:enums/canonical-media-buy-actio.title: Canonical Media Buy Action Mode
external:enums/canonical-media-buy-actio.description: How a seller honors a routed compact-lifecycle action.

enumDescriptions.self_serve: The declared task completes synchronously without approval.
enumDescriptions.conditional_self_serve: The declared task completes synchronously inside seller tolerances and may become asynchronous outside them.
enumDescriptions.seller_managed: The seller processes the action through the standard async lifecycle. The internal use of people, models, queues, or other controls is intentionally opaque.
enumDescriptions.requires_approval: Legacy 3.x mode indicating an approval-dependent async path. New proposal-bound terms SHOULD use seller_managed so they do not expose an internal implementation.

enumDescriptions.pending_creatives: **Buyer-side action required.** The media buy is approved by the seller and has no creatives assigned — the buyer must attach creatives via `sync_creatives` before the buy can serve. Not to be confused with a publisher-side or governance-side approval queue: the seller has already accepted the buy; only the buyer's creative submission is missing. Naming convention: `pending_X` names the lifecycle phase that is next required (here, `creatives`), not a state of waiting on seller/operator approval — consistent with `pending_start` (waiting for the flight date to begin).
enumDescriptions.pending_start: Media buy is ready to serve and waiting for its flight date to begin.
enumDescriptions.rejected: Media buy was declined by the seller after creation
enumDescriptions.canceled: Media buy was terminated before natural completion. Check cancellation.canceled_by to determine whether the buyer or seller initiated.

external:core/sla-window.json.title: SLA Window
external:core/sla-window.json.description: Service-level commitment a seller declares for a given action. Optional throughout: absence means no commitment, not zero commitment — buyers querying SLA fields via #4425's `requires` predicate grammar MUST compose with `present` to avoid silently matching sellers who never declared one. Durations are ISO 8601 duration strings (e.g., `PT4H`, `PT24H`, `P1D`). Predicate evaluators that compare durations MUST normalize before comparison; `P1D` and `PT24H` are equal.

response_max.description: Maximum elapsed time from when the buyer issues the action to when the seller acknowledges receipt (mode-appropriate: synchronous response for self_serve, tolerance decision for conditional_self_serve, or queue acknowledgement for seller_managed and legacy requires_approval). Sellers include weekends and non-working periods in the maximum. ISO 8601 duration.

completion_max.description: Maximum elapsed time from buyer issuing the action to the seller completing it (mutation applied, proposal finalized, or seller-managed decision resolved). Sellers include weekends and non-working periods in the maximum. ISO 8601 duration.

external:media-buy/change-term-constrain.title: Media Buy Change Term Constraints
external:media-buy/change-term-constrain.description: Optional machine-readable bounds on a proposal-bound change right. These constraints narrow the action named by the containing change term; they never grant an additional action or expand the accepted commercial envelope. Sellers omit this object when no portable bound is available, and buyers then treat any opaque conditions as unevaluated rather than assuming the change will be accepted.

max_delta_amount.description: Maximum absolute amount by which the affected budget may change in the direction named by the action.

max_delta_percent.description: Maximum percentage change relative to the current committed value. Values above 100 are valid for increases greater than the current value.

min_result_amount.description: Minimum resulting committed value after the change.

max_result_amount.description: Maximum resulting committed value after the change.

max_change.description: Maximum extension, shortening, or shift in the direction named by the action.

earliest_result.description: Earliest resulting start or end timestamp accepted for this action.

latest_result.description: Latest resulting start or end timestamp accepted for this action.

minimum_notice.description: Minimum elapsed notice before the requested flight change may take effect.

max_additions.description: Maximum packages that may be added by one exercise of the right.

max_removals.description: Maximum packages that may be removed by one exercise of the right.

max_result_count.description: Maximum active package count after the change.

minimum_notice.description: Minimum elapsed notice before pause, resume, cancellation, or another operational action may take effect.

external:core/duration.json.title: Duration
external:core/duration.json.description: A time duration expressed as an interval and unit. Used for frequency cap windows, attribution windows, reach optimization windows, time budgets, and other time-based settings. When unit is 'campaign', interval must be 1 — the window spans the full campaign flight.

interval.description: Number of time units. Must be 1 when unit is 'campaign'.

unit.description: Time unit. 'seconds' for sub-minute precision. 'campaign' spans the full campaign flight.

external:core/acceptance-policy-profile-.title: Acceptance Policy Profile IDs
external:core/acceptance-policy-profile-.description: Acceptance-policy profiles from the seller catalog that apply to this product in addition to seller defaults. Profiles compose restrictively; the most restrictive matching disposition wins.

external:core/context.json.title: Context Object
external:core/context.json.description: Opaque correlation data that is echoed unchanged in responses. Used for internal tracking, UI session IDs, trace IDs, and other caller-specific identifiers that don't affect protocol behavior. Context data is never parsed by AdCP agents - it's simply preserved and returned.
